system.description:
You may use this skill if your subclass is Pirate, Outlaw, or Phantom Thief.
Deal  [2D + (Attack power)] physical damage. 

(Successful Hit): Target drops one item, roll on their loot table. It can not be used more than once on the target that dropped the item in the same scenario.

(Miss): Your [Hate] is increased by 1, but the skill can be used again.

A special skill that steals valuable items from the opponent at the same time as attacking.
